data.narrative:
SandboxAQ, a Series E AI & Software company led by founder Jack Hidary, has raised $950M+ and carries a last post-money valuation of $5.75B. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 9 comparables (1 public, 8 private), including same-sector and adjacent-stage companies such as Applied Intuition ($15.0B, Series F), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), and Ayar Labs ($3.8B, Series E).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.4x step-up multiplier to the $5.75B last round, yielding $8.0B. Peer-median analysis across the three closest stage and sector comps produces $8.6B, with a range spanning $3.8B to $15.0B. These methods support a median implied valuation of $8.3B, with a low bound of $6.8B and high bound of $9.9B.

The analysis supports a range of $6.8B–$9.9B, centered on $8.3B. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion across peer comparables—a 3.9x spread from Ayar Labs to Applied Intuition—and the relatively small sample size of exactly-matching stage peers. The peer set's stage heterogeneity (Series D through F) introduces additional variance. SandboxAQ's specific operational metrics, growth trajectory, and capital efficiency relative to these peers would refine the valuation further.
